field.label: Interface
field.help: Interface (physical or VLAN) the concentrator listens on for PPPoE discovery.

field.label: AC name
field.help: Access concentrator name announced in PADO. Empty uses the system default.

field.label: Service name
field.help: PPPoE service name for this concentrator. Empty accepts any.

field.label: Address pool
field.help: IPv4 pool used for dynamic client addressing.

field.label: Local gateway
field.help: Local IPv4 address of the PPP links (must be outside the pool).

field.label: Maximum sessions
field.help: Session cap for this concentrator. Empty uses the global maximum.

field.label: Idle timeout (s)
field.help: Disconnect after this many seconds without traffic; 0 disables.
